; Instant memo-marker cleanup when a notebook is trashed from the file browser.
;
; The browser action bar's trashEntriesAction() (ActionHeader.qml) calls
; selection.selectionMoveToTrash(). We re-run it but kick a short timer afterward that
; re-validates ALL memo links: for each docId->memoId in rmh-memo-links.cfg whose memo's
; metadata now reads "parent":"trash" (or is gone), strip the parent's 📝/Memo tag and
; drop the dead link. The 800ms delay lets xochitl flush the trashed memo's metadata to
; disk before we read it (reading immediately would race the write). Combined with the
; on-document-open reconciler (memo_tag_reconcile.qmd) this makes the tag disappear right
; after you delete the memo, not only on next open.
;
; Needs Values (common), Library, LibraryController — all in ActionHeader's scope.
AFFECT [[5376273845699449139]]
    TRAVERSE [[4656948266548654837]]#[[15623861903200516464]]
        LOCATE BEFORE ALL INSERT {
            function rmhReconcileAllMemoTags() {
                let rmhLinksPath = "file:///home/root/.local/share/remarkable/xochitl/rmh-memo-links.cfg";
                Values.rmhReadFile(rmhLinksPath, (links0) => {
                    let links = links0 || ({});
                    let ids = Object.keys(links);
                    for (let k = 0; k < ids.length; k++) {
                        let docId = ids[k];
                        let memoId = links[docId];
                        let rmhMetaPath = "file:///home/root/.local/share/remarkable/xochitl/" + memoId + ".metadata";
                        Values.rmhReadFile(rmhMetaPath, (meta) => {
                            if (!meta || meta.parent === "trash") {
                                let pe = Library.entryForId(docId);
                                let pts = (pe && pe.tags) ? pe.tags.map((t) => "" + t) : [];
                                let base = pts.filter((t) => t !== "📝" && t !== "Memo");
                                if (base.length !== pts.length) LibraryController.setEntryTags(docId, base, []);
                                delete links[docId];
                                Values.rmhWriteFile(rmhLinksPath, links);
                            }
                        });
                    }
                });
            }
            Timer {
                id: rmhMemoReconcileTimer
                interval: 800
                onTriggered: actionHeader.rmhReconcileAllMemoTags()
            }
        }
        REPLACE [[10738374345329588483]] WITH {
            function trashEntriesAction() {
                actionHeader.notificationQueue.enqueue({
                    "text": qsTr("%n item(s) were moved to Trash", "", selection.size),
                    "style": Notification.Secondary,
                });
                selection.selectionMoveToTrash();
                rmhMemoReconcileTimer.restart();
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
